 Latest news U.S. benefits The Social Security Admin is sending four payments to some beneficiaries in December: who’s on the list?
 Next month, certain benefits recipients in the U.S. will get as many as four payments from the Social Security Administration.
 NoDerog/Getty Images Corina González twitter Update: Nov 18th, 2026 11:16 EST Share Make us preferred on Google As it does every month, in December the Social Security Administration (SSA) will send out retirement, disability and survivor benefits as part of the Social Security program . In addition, the agency will issue payments under the Supplemental Security Income scheme (SSI).
 Generally, the agency issues one or two payments per month to each beneficiary. Under certain circumstances, however, some recipients can receive more. In December, some beneficiaries will receive as many as four .
 Who will receive four payments in December 2026?
 Each month, some beneficiaries receive two separate payments: one from the SSI program and another from the Social Security scheme .
 While they typically receive two payments per month, these dual beneficiaries will receive four payments in December: two SSI payments and two Social Security payments, because January’s benefits will be issued early .
 The first SSI payment will be sent on Tuesday, December 1, while the first of the two Social Security payments will go out on Thursday, December 3. The second SSI payment, along with the second Social Security payment , will be issued on Thursday, December 31.
 Why will Social Security send four payments to certain beneficiaries?
 The SSI payment issued on December 1 and the Social Security payment sent on December 3 are the regularly scheduled benefits for the final month of the year. T he two payments arriving on December 31, meanwhile, are advance payments .
 Under the SSA’s official payment schedule, beneficiaries who receive two monthly payments generally receive their SSI benefit on the first day of the month and their Social Security payment on the third day of the month. However, when a payment date falls on a federal holiday or a weekend, benefits are paid on the previous business day .
 In this case, because New Year’s Day 2027 falls on January 1, a federal holiday, SSI payments scheduled for that month will be issued early, on Thursday, December 31, 2026 .
 Likewise, because January 3, 2027, falls on a Sunday and January 1 is a holiday, the Social Security payment normally scheduled for January 3 will also be moved up to December 31, 2026 .
 Social Security and SSI payment schedule for Dec. 2026
 Tuesday, Dec. 1: Supplemental Security Income (SSI) benefits 
 Thursday, Dec. 3: Social Security paid to recipients who began receiving Social Security before May 1997 
 Wednesday, Dec. 9: Social Security paid to beneficiaries born between the 1st and the 10th of the month 
 Wednesday, Dec. 16: Social Security paid to beneficiaries born between the 11th and the 20th of the month 
 Wednesday, Dec. 23: Social Security paid to beneficiaries born between the 21st and the 31st of the month 
 Thursday, Dec. 31: SSI benefits for January 2027 
 Also on Dec. 31: Individuals who receive both Social Security and SSI will get both January 2027 payments; January 2027 Social Security payments are also issued to beneficiaries who began receiving benefits before May 1997
